_comment: The join contract for ai-forward, read by docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/conductor-join.py.
recount: the fast ring - the tests that the joined tracks own plus the audit-log suite; the full suite runs in verify-bundle before the push.
regenerate: explicit, in-tree commands (never `coord regen`, which resolved against the primary checkout from a worktree once).
gates: every verify-*.py in tools/ and the deployed script bundle, one exit status (run-verify-gates.py).
No push_remote: main requires linear history, so the coordinator rebuilds the joined tree as a linear commit and pushes over SSH.
recount: leader or join_epoch or mail or doorbell or board or readers or co_s0 or skill_contracts or coord_core or audit_log or compile or session_profile or dream or pack_apply or pack_doctor
